title: Expose authenticated processing and storage health

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Python tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m pytest tests/test_foundation.py tests/unit

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-001 RED: before changing production behavior, an authenticated accepted Photo must fail the exact GET /api/inventory/photos/{photo_id}/processing claim because the route and inventory-owned assembly do not yet expose persisted pending, processing, ready, no_faces and failed truth plus the compatible searchable derivation; retain actual status/body and state comparison in isolated state.

FT-002-AC-001 GREEN: the claim-equivalent photographer flow must record the exact route and response fields across all five persisted statuses, current serving revision, active visibility, state/timestamps/attempts, bounded failure reason, derived searchable label, decisive comparison and unchanged neighboring upload rows.

FT-002-AC-004 RED: before changing production behavior, an operator/developer request with explicit accepted_from/accepted_before must fail to expose the exact full-population counts, exclusions, ratio and nullable 95% verdict from TASK-005's authoritative projection; retain query/status/body and database reconciliation differences.

FT-002-AC-004 GREEN: the same controlled interval must record exact query rules and response fields, every accepted Photo and exclusion locator, persisted times/states, population/success/breach/open counts, strict-under-15-minute comparison, ratio, nullable-until-complete verdict and pass/fail artifact.

FT-002-AC-005 RED: before changing production behavior, a Calibration-held shared-worker fixture must fail to expose current_operation, operation_started_at, queue backlog and unchanged SLO population through the five-second polling health surface; retain absent/stale fields and observed polling results.

FT-002-AC-005 GREEN: the claim-equivalent health flow must record calibration current operation, delayed pending/aged counts and SLO classifications, subsequent idle/photo_processing state and ordinary completion, five-second polling behavior, one worker topology and negative checks for WebSocket, SSE, priority, preemption and extra worker.

FT-002-AC-006 RED: before changing production behavior, an isolated normal/low/unavailable matrix must fail the exact independent PostgreSQL and MinIO capacity contract because configured read-only probes and distinct current results do not yet exist; retain configured thresholds, effective mounts, actual statuses/bytes/errors and any cross-store masking.

FT-002-AC-006 GREEN: the same matrix must record for each store status, available_bytes, positive low_threshold_bytes, observed_at and bounded error across normal, configured-low and unavailable conditions, prove the other store remains truthful, compare queue/failure/recovery values and retain owned cleanup.

FT-002-AC-001 RED: before changing production behavior, an isolated authorization matrix must fail the claim that a photographer may read only their own accepted Photo while operator/developer may read the one-СПА pilot Photo, with missing/revoked session 401, wrong ownership/role 403 and unknown Photo 404; retain every principal, owner, status and no-body-leak comparison.

FT-002-AC-001 GREEN: the claim-equivalent matrix must record own-photo success, foreign-photo 403, operator/developer success, missing/expired/revoked 401, unknown 404, exact principal/Photo identities, unchanged rows and decisive comparisons without broadening platform/auth business ownership.

FT-002-AC-006 RED: before changing production behavior, an isolated health-authorization matrix must fail the exact operator/developer-only page/API claim if a photographer succeeds, an invalid interval avoids 422, or an unknown СПА avoids 404; retain paths, query, principals, statuses and bodies.

FT-002-AC-006 GREEN: the claim-equivalent matrix must record active operator/developer 200, photographer 403, missing/revoked session 401, paired/reversed interval validation 422, unknown СПА 404 and exact page/API fields with pass/fail comparisons.

FT-002-AC-006 / REQ-SEC-001 RED: before changing production behavior, a topology/privacy probe must fail if primary volumes are not read-only to the backend probe or if credentials, authentication state, database/MinIO paths, object keys, embeddings, model paths, mounted data content or commercial media enter responses, URLs or logs; retain effective Compose mounts and redacted observations.

FT-002-AC-006 / REQ-SEC-001 GREEN: the claim-equivalent probe must record read-only effective volume views, absence of a monitoring service or new public port, no storage-content read, complete response/URL/log redaction assertions and decisive comparisons while preserving private PostgreSQL/MinIO topology.

FT-002-AC-006 RED: before changing production behavior, a public-to-owner architecture trace must fail because the exact staff routes do not yet delegate authorization/assembly to inventory and typed state/SLO reads to processing without direct repository access; retain missing delegation and forbidden-placement checks.

FT-002-AC-006 GREEN: the claim-equivalent trace must locate inventory ownership under src/face_moment/inventory/, the accepted processing-status projection call, infrastructure-only capacity values and no business orchestration or foreign state access in HTTP/UI, infrastructure, generic helpers or composition root.

The T3 probe records its unique Compose project, disposable volumes/test credentials, controlled clock, explicit capacity thresholds, task-owned object prefix, safe rerun and cleanup; it never reads mounted data-file content, touches operator/default state or expands permissions.

Independent /verify evidence supplies fresh functional proof for every harm-driving claim and VERDICT: PASS; per-task /red-verify supplies SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass and the explicit owner records HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done before closure.
purpose: Expose the complete FT-002 photographer/operator outcome through inventory-owned authenticated status and health reads without moving processing truth, weakening storage privacy or adding observability infrastructure.
success_outcome: A photographer can poll each own accepted Photo to a truthful current/final processing state, while an operator/developer can inspect current queue, controlled-interval SLO, worker recovery/current operation and independent PostgreSQL/MinIO normal/low/unavailable capacity through the exact same-origin staff surface.
anti_goals: Do not duplicate processing claim, state transition, engine, derivative, face or SLO logic in inventory, HTTP/UI, infrastructure or composition code; use TASK-005's published boundary.
Do not implement FT-012 inventory selection/counters/delete/purge, FT-011 Calibration calculations, realtime search, Promo or QR/session behavior.
Do not add a generic RBAC/IAM service, another session model, monitoring service, metrics store, WebSocket/SSE, public storage port or custom error framework.
Do not expose or read database/object-store data files, object/model/storage paths, credentials, embeddings or commercial media through the capacity proof.

forbidden_scope: Changes to approved FT-001 task identities or replacement of its staff-session contract
Direct inventory/HTTP/UI writes to processing state, faces, derivatives or runtime status
FT-011/FT-012, realtime search, Promo/QR/session and production deployment behavior
Writable shared primary-volume mounts, public internal ports, monitoring/metrics services and operator/default persistent data
stop_conditions: Execution requires changing the exact status/health endpoint, role/ownership, SLO interval, response or standard failure contract.
The user-visible outcome cannot remain owned by inventory or would require direct foreign repository access, handler/generic-util/composition-root business logic or a new architecture edge.
Primary free capacity cannot be observed through configured read-only views without exposing data content, paths, credentials or weakening the private-store topology.
Any harm-driving authorization, topology, redaction or capacity RED/GREEN probe cannot run in already authorized isolated disposable state with safe rerun and owned cleanup.

constraints: Primary orchestration owner is inventory at src/face_moment/inventory/; platform/auth authenticates, inventory authorizes/assembles, processing supplies typed truth and FastAPI/UI only adapt transport.
Implement the exact status/health routes, interval rules, fields and standard failure mappings from the Photo Processing API without a parallel API or custom error framework.
Reuse FT-001 server sessions; photographer access is own-Photo only and processing health is operator/developer only in the one-СПА pilot.

Under REQ-SEC-001, use two configured read-only primary-volume views and positive per-store low thresholds; capacity collection reads filesystem statistics only, preserves private PostgreSQL/MinIO/internal ports and adds no service or public port.
Exact owner-local module/template/static filenames and configured threshold defaults remain implementation discretion where the canonical public/data identities and privacy rules are preserved.
invariants: The public searchable flag is derived from current active Photo, complete ready publication and exact serving revision; the API never relabels incompatible or partial state as searchable.
A photographer cannot read another uploader's Photo; a photographer cannot read processing health; invalid/revoked sessions remain 401 and business authorization stays in inventory.
The two store observations remain independent: low/unavailable PostgreSQL cannot fabricate, erase or reuse MinIO state and vice versa.
Responses and logs contain no credentials, authentication state, storage/model/object paths, embeddings, mounted data content or commercial media.
PostgreSQL, MinIO and internal role ports remain private; the capacity mechanism is read-only and creates no monitoring/metrics lifecycle.
